name: ritual_seal
description: Prayer seal lying flat across a door threshold: two pale ixtle cords crossed in an X and held by a hand-pressed wax disc with a small cross. Shape tells the state (straight = bound, curved = released).

disc_rect.note: 24x24 crop centered on frame 0's wax disc (wax_bbox is the disc + #2e2219 lip excluding the 1-px #0e0c0d rim) for Godot to place as the altar motif.
